policy.promotion_rule: Promote deferred curation decisions only when notes identify semantic/image/voice loss, non-equivalent/interpretive bridge wording, Chinese-derived proper-name/wordplay risk, or an explicit need for JP evidence. Equivalent script conversion alone is not promoted.
policy.canonical_exclusion: Sources already covered by a locked term_registry target or exact skill_name_style canonical example are excluded because their canonical Vietnamese rendering is already enforceable elsewhere.
